status: acoustic/model evidence and critical proposal only; coordinating agent reconciles source timings
scope: All six eagle entrances: 24 four-word and48 restricted two-word model-path tests,96 compact per-entrance comparisons.
method: Cached MMS_FA emissions aligned with standard spelling and explicit acoustic vowel-reduction sensitivity paths. Paths test model ownership instability; editorial lyrics remain unchanged. Original/stem physical review supplies the selected onset, not a majority vote.
limits: Same model family and same emissions across paths; these are sensitivity tests, not independent confirmations.
Reduced-vowel paths may follow accompaniment, skip an occurrence or force wrong character ownership. Rejected paths remain visible.
A model initial-character core is not the earliest reduced vowel. Source mixed audio remains authoritative.
Continuous vowel ownership has a broad signal interval; sample encoding does not imply millisecond accuracy. No human listening attestation.

criticalProposal.reason: Original/stem prior pitched vowel body remains stable through roughly132.25–132.27, then descends/changes around132.28–132.33. The quieter connected opening-vowel trajectory starts there, before the stronger core132.507 and later r132.77–132.81. Earlier132.650 assigned that quiet opening to the previous word. Coupled132.305 ownership replaces it; the range remains broad because adjacent reduced vowels merge without silence.
